text: Crimthann Nia Náir was the son of Lugaidh Riab nDhorg, whom folk called the striped one. His mother Cloe also played the part of his grandmother. That twist points to Clote's role as Sovereignty, a goddess wed remember to every ruling king of her realm in turn. He died in the struggle named the Intoxication of the Ulstermen. At his side too went the stern woman who had raised him, the saucy writer Richis.

okr.objective: Crimthann Nia Náir was a king whose incestuous parentage links him to the goddess of Sovereignty.
key_results: His father was Lugaidh Riab nDerg, the striped man.
His mother Clothra was also his grandmother.
Clothra was the goddess of Sovereignty, married to each king of her land.
He died in the battle of the Intoxication of the Ulstermen.
